result.topic_en: Calculations for spherically symmetric (radial) gas flow: the velocity-potential equation and its transformation, the Riemann-invariant form with $p = u + a\log\varrho$, $q = u - a\log\varrho$ including the geometric source term $\frac{a}{r}$, and characteristic relations $dr - (u\pm a)dt$.
result.transcription:
$c - a^2 \log\varrho = \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial t} + \frac12\left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\right)^2$ \quad $2\,a\,dt = v\,du - \mu\,dm$ \quad $-a^2\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial r} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial t} + u\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}$ \quad $u + a\log\varrho = p$
$-\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial t} = \frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial r}\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial r^2} + \frac{2}{r}\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}$ \quad $-\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial t} = u\frac{\partial\log\varrho}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial r} + \frac{2}{r}u$ \quad $u - a\log\varrho = q$ \quad $2u = p+q$
$dr - (u+a)\,dt = \mu\,dm$ \quad $dr - (u-a)\,dt = v\,dn$
$dp' = \frac{\partial p'}{\partial r}\mu\,dm + 2\frac{au}{r}dt$ \quad $dq' = \frac{\partial q'}{\partial r}v\,dn + 2\frac{au}{r}dt$
$\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial t^2} + \frac12\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\right)^2}{\partial t} = -\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial r\partial t} \pm \frac{\partial\frac12\left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\right)^2}{\partial r}\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r} + \left(\frac{2}{r}\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial r^2}\right)aa$ \quad $(a+u)\frac{\partial p}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial p}{\partial t} + \frac{a}{r}(p+q) = 0$
[-$\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial t^2} + \ldots = \left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\right)^2 aa \ldots$-] \quad $(-a+u)\frac{\partial q}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial q}{\partial t} - \frac{a}{r}(p+q) = 0$
$= \left(aa - \left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\right)^2\right)\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial r^2} - 2\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial r\partial t} + \frac{aa\,2}{r}\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}$ \quad $(a+u)\left(\frac{\partial p}{\partial r} + 2\frac{a}{r}\right) - 2\frac{au}{r} + \frac{\partial p}{\partial t} = 0$
$r\,dp' - 2\,au\,dt = r\frac{\partial p'}{\partial r}(dr - (a+u)dt)$ \quad $(-a+u)\left(\frac{\partial q}{\partial r} - 2\frac{a}{r}\right) - 2\frac{au}{r} + \frac{\partial q}{\partial t} = 0$
$\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial t} = \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial s}\frac{\partial s}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial \sigma}\frac{\partial\sigma}{\partial t}$ \quad $\frac{\partial p'}{\partial r}(a+u) + \frac{\partial p'}{\partial t} = 2\frac{au}{r}$
$\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial t^2} = \frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial s^2}\left(\frac{\partial s}{\partial t}\right)^2$ \quad $\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r} + \alpha$ \quad $r - (a+u)dt$ \quad $\frac{\partial q'}{\partial r}(u-a) + \frac{\partial q'}{\partial t} = 2\frac{au}{r}$
$\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial r\partial t} = \frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial s^2}\frac{\partial s}{\partial r}\frac{\partial s}{\partial t} + \ldots$
$\frac{d\varphi}{dt} = \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial t} + \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\frac{dr}{dt}$ \quad $(a+u)\,dp' = \left(dr\frac{dp'}{dt} - 2\frac{au}{r}\right) + dt\,(u+a)\frac{dp'}{dt}$
$\frac{\partial^2\varphi}{\partial s^2}\left(\left(\frac{\partial s}{\partial t}\right)^2 - \left(aa - \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\right)^2\frac{\partial s}{\partial r}^2 + 2\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\frac{\partial s}{\partial r}\frac{\partial s}{\partial t}\right) = 0$
$\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial t} = \frac{d\varphi}{dt} - \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r} + \alpha\right)$ \quad $\frac{\partial p}{\partial\log r}\left(u+a+(u-a)\right) = 2\frac{au}{r}$
$\left(\frac{dr}{dt}\right)^2 - \left(aa - \left(\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\right)^2\right) \pm 2\frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r}\frac{dr}{dt}$ \quad $\frac{\partial p}{\partial\log r}u = u\frac{a}{r}$[?]
$\frac{\partial s}{\partial t}dt + \frac{\partial s}{\partial r}dr$ \quad $\frac{dr}{dt} - \frac{\partial\varphi}{\partial r} = \pm a$
$dp' - 2\frac{au}{r}dt = dm\,\frac{dp'}{dt}(u+a)$[?] \quad $dp' = \frac{\partial p'}{\partial r}(dr - (a+u)dt) + 2\frac{au}{r}dt$
$\frac{\frac{\partial s}{\partial t}}{\frac{\partial s}{\partial r}} = -\frac{dr}{dt}$ \quad $dq' - 2\frac{au}{r}dt = dn\,\frac{dq'}{dt}(u-a)$[?] \quad $dq' = \frac{\partial q'}{\partial r}(dr - [-\ldots-]dt) + 2\frac{au}{r}dt$
